question: What extreme silencing power does this rite claim even over Brahmā or an all-knowing being?
premises: The effect follows from the preceding procedure.
Even Brahmā or a living being is included.
Even an all-knowing one would become mute.
inference: As a result of this rite, even Brahmā or an all-knowing being would be reduced to muteness.
uncertainties: The contrastive force between brahmāpi and jīvo'pi is rhetorically compressed.
plain_english: Therefore, even Brahmā or even a living being, though all-knowing, would become mute.
